about: Presentation-only stage light per place (stage-light.mjs). sky: 1 open to the sky, 0 indoors (stars and moon). grade: the share of the time-of-day grade the painting takes (default 1; 0.25 for a painting already lit as night). lights: pools that stay lit as the room darkens, at x/y percent of the painting, r a share of its height; tint lamp or fire; item "lamp" lights the pool only while the lamp shines here. stars: the painting's open sky as x0, y0, x1, y1 percent, where stars come out at night; moon: x, y percent and radius as a percent of its height. The rules, saves and shared engine never read this file.
